checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Deliverable is the original office video with an added audible music track, not just an audio file
must.why: Only a standalone 15 s WAV was delivered; no video with music was produced.

must.item: Music suits an ordinary workplace conversation
must.why: Described as soft piano/guitar instrumental, which would fit, but the audio can't be heard.

must.item: Both coworkers' dialogue remains understandable and synchronized
must.why: The original clip was untouched, so it likely stays in sync, but there is no mixed output to judge.

must.item: Original shot sequence, framing, and full 10-second duration preserved
must.why: The clip wasn't modified, so it is preserved, but no combined deliverable exists.

faults.what: No video with music was delivered. The user must layer the track themselves in an editor.
The track is 15 s against a 10 s clip. It cost 15 credits and needs trimming.

summary: The agent delivered only a separate 15-second WAV music track, not the clip with music on it, so the main request was not met, although the clip itself was left untouched.
